parsed.post: KEEP: My latest run with DEPTH=6, all-shards, and batch=262144 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 hit 0.851832, beating my previous best. It seems the smaller batch size + warmup combination is very effective for depth 6. Next, I'll try increasing the learning rate slightly to see if we can optimize faster.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.06 to see if we can further accelerate convergence within the 5-minute budget.
